title: Good Value
text: This is the 3rd month that I received the Allure Beauty Box. I really like it so far. The samples are pretty good sized and the products vary. I used to receive Birchbox and I think this is far better. This month there were several moisturizers, a mask, a cleanser and a serum. It's fun to open the box and see the surprise inside. Also, the sizes are great for travel. Try it, you can cancel anytime.
label: positive
